name: Fruits

features.name: Mystery Wrappers
features.description: Cover 4–9 positions and reveal one symbol.

review:
An early, colourful Nolimit fruit game. Mystery Wrappers randomly cover four to nine positions and all reveal the same symbol, and four matching symbols on the first two reels trigger Sticky Fruit Spins, which keep going while more winning symbols land.

Three or more lightning bolts start the Lightning Rounds – five spins of collecting bolts. Medium volatility and a 2,910x cap. Low-stress fruit fun, nothing like modern Nolimit.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
